item.title: FET scheduled delist (postponed)
item.description: Status: postponed Market: perp Effective time: 2024-06-12T08:00:00Z Settlement described as: mark_price Source: https://t.me/hyperliquid_announcements/190 FET-USD will be delisted on June 12 at 08:00 UTC. This shorter than usual notice is due to a lack of clarity around the timing of the merger of FET, AGIX, and OCEAN to ASI. All positions will be settled at mark price, and open orders will be canceled. Close any positions beforehand to avoid automatic settlement. After settlement, FET-USD perps will be delisted, and no new orders will be accepted.

Markets are delisted sequentially, with one market entering delisting pricing each hour from 10:00 to 15:00 UTC daily, concluding on 02 September 2026 at 15:00 UTC.
